7980.title: ACP prompt settlement and unfinished commands
7980.rootCauseOneLine: ACP end_turn settles successfully and closes unfinished tool items; workflow idle handling accepts plain output as success.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed and unmerged; static proposal spans nine files and vendor-specific fallback policy.

7980.proposedFix: Establish vendor lifecycle authority, then add narrowly scoped provider error and unfinished-command handling with cancellation and steering coverage.
7980.caveats: Two clean synthetic ACP runs reproduce the bridge mechanism, not live vendor behavior, exact capacity-banner handling, native swarm permissions, or workflow archival. Reproduction code is embedded inline under the public reports repository policy.
